## Our rockets
We are currently working on two rockets, [STARGAZE](https://www.bears-space.de/projects/Stargaze/) and [MOONDUST](https://www.bears-space.de/projects/Moondust/).
Our second rocket, launched in September 2024, was [STARDUST](https://www.bears-space.de/projects/Stardust/).
Our first rocket, launched in October 2022, was [STARMOON](https://www.bears-space.de/projects/Starmoon/).

## Our team
In the rocket systems group we build our own rockets. 
We have already achieved two successful launches, one to an altitude of 1.5 km and one to an altitude of 600 m.
